home_win.note: Expected ~0.5 if home field did not matter. This is the base correlation between any two legs that both require a home win.

parlay_math.warning: With -110 on each leg a 2-leg parlay needs both legs to hit 52.4% of the time; 3 legs need 36.4%; 4 legs need 25.3%. Compounding correlation and vig is why parlay edges are harder to certify than single-bet edges.
